acceptanceCriteria: Each listed abstention records a named adapter-degradation code in the self-observation ledger while the host output stays non-blocking.
The OpenCode plugin reports when changed paths exceed MAX_TRACKED_PATHS.
Tests cover an unknown Codex event, an out-of-project post-tool path and the path cap.
body: Filed 2026-10-04 from the V1-0712 output-class inventory (docs/build-log/2026-10-04-v1-0712-output-class-inventory.md), source origin/main a2615609. Idea; the fail-open policy (AHI-044, V1-0711) is unchanged. Several adapter paths abstain silently where a sibling path names a code: runCodexAdapter returns {} for an unknown hook_event_name (cmd/corvint/host_adapter.go:286); Claude post-tool turns a tool_input path outside the project into an empty changedPaths list (host_adapter.go:539-551), while file-change refuses the same input as file-change-path-not-project-relative; the OpenCode plugin ignores a path normalizeRepositoryPath rejects and stops adding paths past MAX_TRACKED_PATHS (256) without a truncation flag (integrations/opencode/src/index.js:212-219). The hook output can stay non-blocking while the self-observation ledger records the abstention.

completion.reason: PR beamfall/corvint#571 merged into main as fecce039f8c68323e8b1e8fa016a477d42bf33a9. Host adapters now name silent abstentions without blocking output (AHI-044 unchanged): the Codex unhandled event records SOL-V0-010 unsupported-hook-event, the Claude Code out-of-project post-tool target records post-tool-path-not-project-relative, and the OpenCode plugin names post-tool-path-not-project-relative and changed-paths-truncated at console.info. AC1 PARTIAL: the Codex and Claude Code abstentions are ledgered, but the OpenCode codes reach console.info rather than the self-observation ledger; that residual is tracked as V1-0767 (receipt 2744). AC2 met (changed-paths-truncated at the 256-path cap). AC3 met: TestAdapterSilentAbstentionsAreLedgered (cmd/corvint) and the AHI-022 V1-0746 case in integrations/host-adapters.test.mjs cover an unknown Codex event, an out-of-project post-tool path and the path cap. Focused tests and doc gates passed, PR CI was green, Codex review findings were applied in 88334a0c, and the CEM was sealed at 0fc62c8a. Evidence: sha256 at fecce039 of the build log docs/build-log/2026-10-04-v1-0746-adapter-abstention-codes.md, cmd/corvint/host_adapter_test.go and integrations/host-adapters.test.mjs. Completed by the orchestrator at the request of the authoring session.

title: Host adapters drop unrecognised events and out-of-project paths without a degradation code
